name: GUI.beginTable
signature: GUI.beginTable(id:string,columns:integer,flags?:integer,height?:number):boolean - 1..64 columns; only end when true. ScrollY needs height.

name: GUI.endTable
signature: GUI.endTable() - Table scope operation; set up columns before rows.

name: GUI.tableNextRow
signature: GUI.tableNextRow() - Table scope operation; set up columns before rows.

name: GUI.tableHeadersRow
signature: GUI.tableHeadersRow() - Table scope operation; set up columns before rows.

name: GUI.tableSetupColumn
signature: GUI.tableSetupColumn(label:string,width?:number) - Fixed width when positive, otherwise stretch.

name: GUI.tableGetColumnIndex
signature: GUI.tableGetColumnIndex():integer - Current zero-based index or column count.

name: GUI.tableGetColumnCount
signature: GUI.tableGetColumnCount():integer - Current zero-based index or column count.

name: GUI.beginMenuBar
signature: GUI.beginMenuBar():boolean - Requires GUI.WindowFlags.MenuBar on beginWindow. Only end when true.

name: GUI.pushStyleColor
signature: GUI.pushStyleColor(name:string,r:number,g:number,b:number,a?:number) - Use GUI.Col constants; pair with popStyleColor.

name: GUI.popStyleColor
signature: GUI.popStyleColor(count?:integer) - Strict reverse-order scoped pop; default 1.

name: GUI.popStyleVar
signature: GUI.popStyleVar(count?:integer) - Strict reverse-order scoped pop; default 1.

name: GUI.beginDragDropSource
signature: GUI.beginDragDropSource():boolean - Only end when true. Script payloads isolated from editor payloads.

name: GUI.beginDragDropTarget
signature: GUI.beginDragDropTarget():boolean - Only end when true. Script payloads isolated from editor payloads.

name: GUI.setDragDropPayload
signature: GUI.setDragDropPayload(kind:string,value:string) - Source only. Type max 28 bytes; value max 4096.

name: GUI.acceptDragDropPayload
signature: GUI.acceptDragDropPayload(kind:string):string? - Target only. Returns delivered matching script payload or nil.

name: GUI.isKeyDown
signature: GUI.isKeyDown(key:string):boolean - Named key: A..Z, 0..9, Space, Enter, Escape, Tab, Backspace, Delete, arrows.

name: GUI.isKeyReleased
signature: GUI.isKeyReleased(key:string):boolean - Named key: A..Z, 0..9, Space, Enter, Escape, Tab, Backspace, Delete, arrows.

name: getTextureQuality
signature: getTextureQuality():integer - Effective texture quality: 0 full, 1 half, 2 quarter, 3 eighth.

name: setTextureQuality
signature: setTextureQuality(quality:integer) - Play-only override 0..3; Stop restores project default.

name: GUI
signature: GUI - ImGui runtime interface namespace, not a component. Draw widgets only inside onGUI(), called each rendered Game frame; no wait/task. Windows are scoped per script/object and rendered into Game, including the separate Game window. UI is the RML/RCSS component.

name: GUI.beginWindow
signature: GUI.beginWindow(title:string,flags?:integer):boolean - Always call endWindow even when false.

name: GUI.text
signature: GUI.text(value:string) - Plain text, never a printf format.

name: GUI.collapsingHeader
signature: GUI.collapsingHeader(label:string):boolean - True while expanded; no matching end.

name: GUI.beginDisabled
signature: GUI.beginDisabled(disabled?:boolean) - Default true; pair with endDisabled.

name: GUI.pushID
signature: GUI.pushID(id:string) - Scope repeated widget labels; pair with popID.

name: GUI.setNextWindowPos
signature: GUI.setNextWindowPos(x:number,y:number) - Game-surface pixels; call before beginWindow.

name: GUI.isItemHovered
signature: GUI.isItemHovered():boolean - Whether last widget is hovered.

name: GUI.isItemActive
signature: GUI.isItemActive():boolean - Whether last widget is active.

name: UI
signature: UI - Game overlay component. Assign project-relative rml (.rml) and rcss (.rcss) assets in Inspector; both required. enabled toggles display. Use self:getComponent(UI) or @export hud UI. gui:isLoaded(), gui:setText(id, plainText), gui:onClick(id, callback) registers once and returns an off(token) subscription; gui:onClick(id) polls a pending click. No automatic UI folder loading or global ui table.

name: Vector3
signature: Vector3(x,y,z) - Construct a vector table accepted by position, rotation, destination and obstacle vector setters.

name: NavMeshObstacle
signature: NavMeshObstacle - Dynamic conservative box avoidance for NavMeshAgent. Fields enabled, size and center (local-space Vector3, assign whole vectors). Excluded from navigation bake. No runtime carving; detours are bounded to 32 obstacles.

name: NavMeshAgent
signature: NavMeshAgent - Transform movement over a baked Recast navmesh. Fields enabled, speed (0..100), stoppingDistance (0.01..10), stopped, destination (complete world-space vector). Methods setDestination(x,y,z or vector), resetPath(). Read-only hasPath, pathPending, remainingDistance, velocity, status. Bake static objects/terrains in Windows > Navigation. Agent origin is at feet. No rigidbody/controller/camera movement drivers. updateRotation (default true)/angularSpeed control automatic path-facing heading; NavMeshObstacle boxes support bounded dynamic detours.

name: TPSCamera
signature: TPSCamera - Third person target/parent follow camera. Fields: enabled, target (GameObject or nil for parent), offset (complete world-space vector), mouseLook, lockMouse (bool, default false; locks cursor only in focused Play), collision, distance/minDistance/maxDistance, yaw/pitch/minPitch/maxPitch (degrees), sensitivity, zoomSpeed, smoothing, shoulder, collisionRadius. Read-only resolvedDistance. During Play, hold right mouse or lock cursor to orbit; wheel zooms. Requires Camera+Transform, colliders for obstruction avoidance; incompatible with FPSCamera. Use Camera APIs on getComponent(Camera).

name: affectEnvironment
signature: Skybox.affectEnvironment: boolean, opt-in sky-colored ambient illumination on lit meshes, terrain and foliage; not shadowed GI

name: environmentIntensity
signature: Skybox.environmentIntensity: 0..5, default 1; used when affectEnvironment is true

name: Water
signature: Water - shared River water settings on arbitrary static .mesh or built-in MeshRenderer geometry; mesh (optional asset), shaderStyle (0..7), waveHeight, waveLength, waveSpeed. Upward triangles define buoyancy and contact coverage; not a sealed fluid volume. Ignores own solid collider/rigid-body integration.

name: BoneAttachment
signature: BoneAttachment - enabled, source (animated GameObject), node (skeleton index), offset (complete vector), rotation (Euler degrees complete vector). Drives Transform position/rotation from evaluated bone pose; errors are read-only. Avoid dynamic RigidBody and attachment dependency cycles.

name: shaderStyle
signature: Water/River.shaderStyle: 0 Classic, 1 Clear, 2 Ocean, 3 Lake, 4 Rapids, 5 Tropical, 6 Marsh, 7 Industrial canal (screenshot-inspired approximation)

name: waveHeight
signature: Water/River.waveHeight: 0..3 metres, geometric waves; zero disables displacement

name: waveSpeed
signature: Water/River.waveSpeed: 0..10 multiplier; Flowing and flow speed also apply

name: Vehicle
signature: Vehicle - four-wheel raycast chassis, local -Z forward. enabled; throttle (-1..1), steering (-1..1), brake (0..1), handbrake (boolean). Read-only speed (signed m/s), groundedWheels, isGrounded, wheelCompression (copy, FL/FR/RL/RR). Settings: centerOfMassX, centerOfMassY, centerOfMassZ (local chassis offset metres, default 0; negative Y lowers COM), wheelBase, trackWidth, mountHeight, wheelRadius, suspensionLength, springStrength, suspensionDamping, antiRollStrength, engineForce, brakeForce, tireGrip, maxSteerAngle (degrees), maxSpeed (m/s). Requires dynamic primitive chassis; adding supplies missing dependencies only.

name: throttle
signature: Vehicle.throttle: -1..1, negative reverse, commands persist until reassigned

name: handbrake
signature: Vehicle.handbrake: boolean, rear-wheel braking with reduced lateral grip

name: CloudSystem
signature: CloudSystem - enabled, volumetric (false=2D, true=volume), color, size, coverage, density, scale, speed, opacity, steps (4..24). Vector getters return copies; assign a complete vector table. Requires Transform.

name: River
signature: River - enabled, color, width, opacity, speed, flowing, flowAmount (0..2), transparent, collisionEffects, collisionStrength (0..2), waveScale, waveStrength, foam, subdivisions (2..32), points (2..64 local vectors). Getters return copies; assign the complete points list to update the curve. Requires Transform; visual water, no fluid physics.

name: Fog
signature: Fog - enabled, color (complete RGB vector), density (0..10), start (>=0), end (>start, <=1000000). Global distance fog; first enabled active entity wins. Use bracket notation for the end field (a Lua keyword).

name: fadeToColor
signature: fadeToColor(rgb) -> ColorFade for the current active camera; RGB 0..1, e.g. color.black. Call start(seconds=1) to fade to opaque, stop(seconds=1) to fade to transparent; 0..3600 playing seconds, 0 immediate. Controllers share camera state.

name: CameraEffects
signature: CameraEffects - optional OpenGL camera post effects; enabled, bloom, colorGrading, vignette, depthOfField, motionBlur, filmGrain, chromaticAberration, antiAliasing, ambientOcclusion, nightVision, nausea; bloomIntensity, bloomThreshold, exposure, contrast, saturation, temperature, vignetteIntensity, focusDistance, focusRange, dofStrength, motionStrength, grainIntensity, aberrationStrength, aoIntensity, aoRadius, nightVisionMode (0 green, 1 infrared-style), nightVisionIntensity (0..1), nauseaIntensity (0..1), nauseaSpeed (0..5). All effects default off; motion blur is camera-only; antiAliasing uses FXAA-style filtering.

name: LightShafts
signature: LightShafts - fast visual shaft; enabled, direction, height, width, endWidth, color, intensity, density, falloff, streaks, fade, nearFade, useBakedTexture and texture

name: Laser
signature: Laser - local -Z collider-clipped beam; enabled, color, intensity, range, width, glowWidth, impactSize; hit, endPosition and hitNormal are read-only

name: ParticleSystem
signature: ParticleSystem - billboard emitter; play(), pause(), resume(), stop(clear=true), restart(), clear(), emit(count), setPreset(Fire/Smoke/Sparkles/Blood/Explosion); configurable emission, shape, motion, color, size and opt-in sprite sheet (useSpriteSheet=false by default); particleCount/isPlaying/paused/time read-only

name: Animation
signature: Animation - keyframed component; clip, loop, playOnStart; play(), stop(), pause(), resume(), reset(), crossFade(clip, seconds=0.25); isPlaying is read-only

name: getComponentInParent
signature: getComponentInParent(Type) / getComponentInParent(object, Type) / object:getComponentInParent(Type) -> live component or nil; self first, then nearest parent

name: getComponentInChildren
signature: getComponentInChildren(Type) / getComponentInChildren(object, Type) / object:getComponentInChildren(Type) -> live component or nil; self first, then breadth-first descendants

name: findComponentInParent
signature: findComponentInParent(Type) / findComponentInParent(object, Type) / object:findComponentInParent(Type) -> alias of getComponentInParent

name: findComponentInChildren
signature: findComponentInChildren(Type) / findComponentInChildren(object, Type) / object:findComponentInChildren(Type) -> alias of getComponentInChildren

name: meshDetail
signature: Collider.meshDetail: integer 2..15 (default 8), 15 preserves source triangles; lower simplifies the static mesh

name: onCollisionEnter
signature: onCollisionEnter(collider) - solid Rigidbody contact begins; collider exposes gameObject and transform

name: onCollisionStay
signature: onCollisionStay(collider) - solid contact persists during a physics step

name: onCollisionExit
signature: onCollisionExit(collider) - solid contact ends; other collider may be nil if removed

name: Raycast
signature: Raycast - Line, adjustable LineOfSight fan, or Sphere overlap query component

name: color
signature: color.red, green, blue, white, black, yellow, cyan, magenta, gray, orange, purple, pink - RGB vectors

name: setLayers
signature: query:setLayers({'Default','Enemies'}) - ignore other layers before finding hits

name: addForce
signature: body:addForce(x,y,z) - world force for next fixed step; also accepts a vector table

name: addImpulse
signature: body:addImpulse(x,y,z) - world impulse for next fixed step

name: movePosition
signature: body:movePosition(x,y,z) - world position, teleport rather than sweep

name: moveRotation
signature: body:moveRotation(x,y,z) - Euler degrees, or quaternion table

name: onTriggerExit
signature: onTriggerExit(collider) - overlap ends; collider may be nil if destroyed

name: CharacterController
signature: CharacterController - upright capsule movement, grounded jumping and sprinting

name: FPSCamera
signature: FPSCamera - Camera extension with native mouse look and optional freecam movement

name: move
signature: controller:move(x,z) - persistent local direction; forward is negative Z, no deltaTime multiplication

name: jump
signature: controller:jump() - request a grounded jump if canJump

name: sprint
signature: controller:sprint(enabled=true) - request sprint if canSprint and moving

name: linkToCharacter
signature: fps:linkToCharacter(controller, x,y,z) - parent using local position offset

name: spawn
signature: spawn(prefabPathOrGameObject, position, rotation) -> new GameObject root

name: destroy
signature: destroy(gameObject, delay=0) - destroy subtree now or after playing seconds

name: task
signature: task(function() ... end) - run an independent cooperative block; waits pause only that task; call inside lifecycle/object callbacks or tasks

name: waitForSeconds
signature: waitForSeconds(seconds) - suspend this callback, not the engine

name: wait
signature: wait(seconds) / wait(audioSource.onAudioFinished) - suspend this callback/task until time or the next audio event

name: on
signature: on(eventName, callback) -> listener token; receives queued custom events

name: off
signature: off(token) -> boolean; remove this script's listener

name: emit
signature: emit(eventName, ...) -> boolean; queue up to eight primitive arguments

name: onLevelLoaded
signature: onLevelLoaded(name) - destination callback after its scripts start

name: onLevelFailedToLoad
signature: onLevelFailedToLoad(name, error) - current level stays active

name: fadeSkybox
signature: fadeSkybox(destination, speed) or fadeSkybox(source, destination, speed) - activate destination after smooth crossfade

name: loadLevel
signature: loadLevel(name=nil) -> accepted, error; switch at next frame boundary

name: loadLevelAsync
signature: loadLevelAsync(name=nil) -> accepted, error; background file read

name: unloadLevel
signature: unloadLevel(name=nil) -> accepted, error; unload current level

name: restartLevel
signature: restartLevel() -> accepted, error; reload current level from disk

name: setCurrentLevel
signature: setCurrentLevel(name) -> accepted, error; alias for loadLevel

name: nextLevel
signature: nextLevel() -> accepted, error; next registered level, no wrapping

name: previousLevel
signature: previousLevel() -> accepted, error; previous registered level, no wrapping

name: DirectionalLight
signature: DirectionalLight - dynamic directional illumination and shadows

name: PointLight
signature: PointLight - dynamic omnidirectional light with range and six shadow faces

name: SpotLight
signature: SpotLight - cone light with innerAngle/outerAngle in degrees; cookie is a project-relative projected RGB/alpha image, empty disables

name: Texture
signature: Texture - export-only image or HDR asset path; @export image Texture

name: AudioListener
signature: AudioListener - receives sound at its GameObject world position; pause() disables reception, start() enables it

name: fadeIn
signature: audio:fadeIn(seconds) - restart and fade from silence

name: lockCursor
signature: lockCursor() -> boolean; viewport-confined motion, cursor hidden

name: debug
signature: debug - safe logging only; no Lua debug introspection

name: error
signature: debug.error(...) - write an error without throwing

name: setActive
signature: object:setActive(enabled=true) - activity inherited by children; Camera also selects active camera

name: onGUI
signature: onGUI() - Called once per rendered Game frame during unpaused Play. GUI calls are valid only here; no wait/task.

name: hdrCompression
signature: Skybox.hdrCompression: boolean, default false. Packed RGB9_E5 GPU HDR storage (4 bytes/pixel instead of RGB16F 6); lower precision, source unchanged.

name: onFixedUpdate
signature: onFixedUpdate(deltaTime) - before each 1/60 s physics step

name: onDestroy
signature: onDestroy() - object destruction or runtime shutdown/reset

name: destroyGameObject
signature: destroyGameObject(gameObject) - immediately destroy object and all descendants

name: getComponent
signature: getComponent(Type) / getComponent(gameObject, Type) / object.getComponent(Type) -> live component or nil

name: addComponent
signature: addComponent(gameObject, componentType) / component:addComponent(Type) -> live component on the same owner

name: setParent
signature: setParent(child, parentOrNil) - keep world pose; reject cycles

name: Skybox
signature: Skybox - component type token; first enabled Skybox supplies scene background

name: setType
signature: sky:setType('Textures'|'HDR') - Cubemap or HDR skybox (Textures is a legacy alias)

name: setMaterialTexture
signature: mesh:setMaterialTexture(Texture) - instance albedo override; nil clears

name: setMaterialNormalMap
signature: mesh:setMaterialNormalMap(Texture) - instance normal map override; nil clears

name: centerOfMassX
signature: Vehicle.centerOfMassX: -10..10 local metres, default 0. Chassis center-of-mass offset; collision geometry stays in place.

name: centerOfMassY
signature: Vehicle.centerOfMassY: -10..10 local metres, default 0. Negative values lower the chassis center of mass without locking rotation.

name: centerOfMassZ
signature: Vehicle.centerOfMassZ: -10..10 local metres, default 0. Chassis center-of-mass offset along local Z.

name: antiRollStrength
signature: Vehicle.antiRollStrength: 0..200000 N/m, default 12000. Ground-contact axle load transfer; zero disables. Does not lock chassis rotation.

name: setMaterialAlpha
signature: mesh:setMaterialAlpha(value) - 0..1 opacity multiplier for Diffuse Transparent; defaults to 1.

name: self
signature: self - GameObject owning the attached Lua Script

name: floatOnRivers
signature: RigidBody.floatOnRivers: boolean, default false. Dynamic bodies with gravity and primitive non-trigger colliders receive river buoyancy, water drag and gentle bobbing.

name: shape
signature: Collider.shape: Box | Sphere | Capsule | Cone | Mesh; Collider.model selects a static .mesh triangle source

name: mesh
signature: MeshRenderer.mesh: Cube | Sphere | Capsule | Cone | Plane
